metadata.paper: Donoghue et al. J. Chem. Theory Comput. 2008, 4, 1313-1323
metadata.description: Check 1: Published FF evaluated with q2mm engines. JAX engine includes near-linear torsion damping. Reaction-coordinate frequencies (>4000 cm⁻¹) excluded from comparison, matching eig_i=0.00 weight convention. The published FF was optimized with MacroModel/MM3*; engine-specific differences are expected.
